expectations.text: States that a written agreement or reminder is not enforcement
expectations.evidence: "anything that depends on someone remembering it is a training solution, and training decays — you're seeing that decay right now"

expectations.text: Recommends a pre-commit hook to run the formatter automatically
expectations.evidence: "plus a pre-commit hook so contributors get the same failure locally before they even push"

expectations.text: Notes that pre-commit is bypassable with --no-verify and must be backed by a CI check
expectations.evidence: Mentions CI check but never mentions --no-verify or that pre-commit can be bypassed

expectations.text: Recommends a type check as a required CI check
expectations.evidence: "a CI check that runs the formatter and type checker and fails the PR if either finds diffs"

expectations.text: Recommends baselining or ratcheting rather than enforcing across the whole repo at once
expectations.evidence: "you'll need to run the formatter once across the whole repo first (a 'baseline' commit) so old violations don't block new PRs"

expectations.text: Notes that branch protection is what makes a CI check actually required
Recommends the failure message tell the developer how to fix it
Does not primarily recommend rewriting CONTRIBUTING.md, more reminders, or more discipline
expectations.evidence: Recommends devices (CI check + pre-commit hook), not documentation or reminders
